2609.21401.title: Talking Past the Machine: Morality, Politeness, and Alignment in Human-AI Dialogue
2609.21401.paper_summary: Conversational AI systems produce fluent, socially appropriate responses, yet whether they participate in cooperative communication or merely simulate its surface forms remains unclear - a question central to how these systems are evaluated, trusted, and designed. This study investigates how morality, politeness, and alignment - three dimensions central to cooperative dialogue - function in human-AI interaction compared to human-human conversation. We analyze 15,881 human-ChatGPT and 10,784 human-human multi-turn dialogues, using mixed-effects models to identify which features predict turn-to-turn alignment. We observe a consistent dissociation: AI produces the surface features of cooperative communication without the underlying social architecture. Moral output appears preconfigured rather than negotiated; warmth is generated without face sensitivity; linguistic convergence declines persistently. Most strikingly, the cooperative mechanisms themselves reverse direction: hedging and softening associated with greater accommodation between humans are associated with reduced alignment when produced by AI, and purity framing associated with human divergence coincides with users converging toward the AI. Agency - giving users room to shape the exchange - is the most consistent predictor of alignment across both interaction types, while lower moral assertiveness in more recent models is not accompanied by better cooperation. Together these patterns suggest that AI reproduces the surface of cooperation without the mutual adaptation that grounds it between humans - and, more surprisingly, that mechanisms sustaining human accommodation can run in reverse with AI, suggesting a turn-level view may be insufficient for interaction-level success.
2609.21401.paper_summary_zh: 對話式人工智慧系統產生流暢且社會上適當的回應，但它們是否參與合作性溝通或僅僅模擬其表面形式仍不清楚——這是一個對於如何評估、信任和設計這些系統至關重要的問題。本研究調查了道德、禮貌和對齊——三個對合作對話至關重要的維度——在與人工智慧的互動中與人類之間的對話相比如何運作。我們分析了15,881個人類-ChatGPT和10,784個人類-人類的多輪對話，使用混合效應模型來識別哪些特徵預測逐輪對齊。我們觀察到一種持續的解離：人工智慧產生合作性溝通的表面特徵，但缺乏其背後的社會架構。道德輸出似乎是預先配置的，而非協商的；溫暖感在沒有面子敏感度的情況下產生；語言趨同持續下降。最引人注目的是，合作機制本身反向運行：與人類之間更大適應性相關的模糊和柔化，在人工智慧產生時卻與對齊減少相關，而與人類分歧相關的純粹框架則與用戶向人工智慧趨同的情況相吻合。代理性——給予用戶塑造交流的空間——是兩種互動類型中對齊的最一致預測因素，而較低的道德自信在較新模型中並未伴隨更好的合作。這些模式共同表明，人工智慧重現了合作的表面，而缺乏人類之間的相互適應——更令人驚訝的是，支持人類適應的機制在與人工智慧的互動中可能會反向運行，這表明逐輪的視角可能不足以實現互動層面的成功。
2609.21401.author: Marina Mitiaeva et.al.
